About this dashboard

For a family-office client and advisor reviewing a USD reserve needed in the coming months. It compares saved U.S. Treasury bill maturities with planned payment dates and shows how purchasing power could change under an inflation assumption the user chooses.

Data: U.S. Treasury Daily Treasury Bill Rates (bank discount quotes, maturity dates, CUSIPs) and BLS CPI-U, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted. Both are saved snapshots, refreshed by the project's maintenance process; the quote date and its age are shown at the top.

Limits: saved quotes are not executable offers; purchase, settlement, receipt of funds, taxes and fees are not assessed; the inflation rate is an assumption, not a forecast; the dashboard never ranks or recommends a bill.

Educational project. Not investment advice.
